ordering: freeze this gold-authoring/sealing protocol before any fresh target source byte is read
freeze exact opaque structural extractor identity before any fresh target source byte is read
machine-only materialize and seal exactly ten opaque units under the frozen extractor; no human/ChatGPT source inspection
zero-exposure re-arm the exact final Gate2Eprime execution implementation
execute full RISU, every preregistered applicable baseline, every preregistered ablation, and independent pretruth checkers on the sealed ten without any gold access
freeze and content-address the complete pretruth machine-output bundle
only after the pretruth bundle freeze may gold authoring begin
freeze gold bundle independently without reading RISU/baseline/ablation predictions or evaluator outcomes
join sealed pretruth outputs to sealed gold only after both roots are immutable
run the inherited Gate2D evaluator and independent checker twice and require logical byte identity

gold_authoring.input_identity: the already sealed exact-ten staging root only
admissible_evidence: exact source bytes belonging to the sealed unit and mechanically bound local context at the frozen repository HEAD
repository-local declarations/configuration mechanically linked to the sealed unit
authoritative external specification/documentation only when its identity and relevance are recorded in the gold evidence record
inadmissible_evidence: unrecorded operator intuition as sole authority
record_requirements: gold_outcome under the inherited Gate2D truth taxonomy
minimal evidence locators and content digests sufficient to audit the adjudication
authority class for each claim-critical evidence item
gold_authoring.uncertainty_rule: If admissible evidence cannot establish a required gold fact, mark GOLD_UNRESOLVED. Never guess and never coerce gold uncertainty into PRESERVATION, REGRESSION, or an execution INCOMPLETE outcome.
gold_authoring.no_replacement_rule: Any GOLD_UNRESOLVED unit remains one of the sealed ten. It cannot be replaced. If inherited evaluation requires resolved gold for a hard metric, the challenge closes as GOLD_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT rather than silently changing the denominator.

independent_gold_check.checker_input: sealed source/evidence record plus candidate gold record only; no machine predictions
requirements: recompute all mechanical bindings and content digests
verify every claim-critical evidence locator resolves inside the frozen unit/repository identity or explicitly recorded authoritative external identity
independently recompute the truth-taxonomy mapping from the recorded evidence obligations
reject definitive gold when evidence is missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or outside the sealed identity
independent_gold_check.disagreement_rule: Any definitive author/checker disagreement is fail-closed GOLD_DISAGREEMENT. No tie-breaking after predictions are known and no unit replacement.
